pair_rule: For every distinct pair among the 11 rows, a pinned catalog route exists; a guarded match can emit a finite approved word/phrase with target reading when required, otherwise it abstains. This does not establish that arbitrary messages emit.
speech_qualification: Android actual synthetic controller offline 110/110; no playback feeding underruns, one terminal drain underrun per row. iOS simulator 108 new + 2 prior routes completed; listening and pronunciation not assessed. These do not prove selected voice on each Android row, acoustic quality, real device performance or real conversation coverage.
identified_limits: Latin readings are mandatory for non-Latin immersion target spans. The original known/source language is not generally transliterated. This report does not interpret that as a new source-reading requirement.

The target audit structurally checked 5,482 non-Latin-target frame patterns and 16,120 legacy rows; it did not validate pronunciation/meaning. Thirty-five authored whole-sentence readings contain question marks or commas rejected by the shared validator. They occur in 468 reference rows; this is not a count of actual display failures or gains, because other guards also apply.

Explicit Full translation may show Arabic script when no Latin reading exists. Automatic non-Latin target spans are still gated on a reading. No arbitrary Arabic full-sentence transliteration claim is made.
Existing synthetic measurements do not establish broad ordinary-message coverage, accurate translation in every context, or human-reviewed pronunciation.

Apple uses native voices where available and bundled Swahili; native voice availability/preparation depends on the device. Android chooses installed offline voice or pinned 11-language bundled fallback. Voice preparation may fail and is shown as unavailable.
Android a52 actual synthetic full-app en→ja/sw routes and Apple actual native routes/Simulator Japanese display pass. Final signed artifact and broader classifier interactions need separate evidence.
Inactive lexical catalog 008/009 experiments are not evidence for 007 production coverage; this does not refer to separately accepted contextual-frame assets.
